reply.text: I need to look up what happened on Tuesday to understand the soreness better. Nothing's logged for the past week. I can't see what Tuesday was, so I'll work with what you're telling me: your chest is sore. That's normal soreness from a session, not an injury issue, and it doesn't mean you skip the workout. Push day today should feel fine — the soreness usually settles once you're warm, and moving helps. If you feel something sharp or different, that's the time to stop and reassess.
